The pinned class documentation defines the whole contract the game sees: sound/stream ids, priority-then-age voice stealing at maxStreams, play() returning stream id 0 when the new sound loses, calls on a stale stream id being tolerated without error, rate range 0.5-2.0, and loop counting. All of it is finite local state over a host mixer.
